subject: Request: Cross-cloud Early Access Listing + Private Offer Carveout (StellarRetail)
messages:
From: Matt Quinn <m.quinn@stellarretail.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot: cross-cloud listing + private offers for early access

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost profile looked promising for our storefront personalization pilot. We want to move quickly and get a private-offer + listing up in both AWS and Azure marketplaces for a 6-month early access pilot (North America only).

Ask: can Redwood provide a bundled concession for the pilot: a blended marketplace listing credit of ~40% first-year equivalent (applied to committed pilot spend) and waiver of the one-time listing fee? We need the pricing concession spelled out in a private offer so our procurement team can approve.

Attached is a high-level usage forecast and draft SOW (pilot_SOW.pdf / usage_forecast.xlsx). If you need any more detail, I can loop procurement (cc'd).

Best,
Matt Quinn
Head of Product
StellarRetail
procurement@stellarretail.com

--
Attachment: usage_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
Attachment: pilot_SOW.pdf (pdf, 128KB)

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot: cross-cloud listing + private offers for early access

Ben / Lauren — forwarding StellarRetail's request. Key points: cross-cloud (AWS + Azure) private offers + marketplace listing; ask is ~40% blended credit + listing fee waiver for initial pilot. Attachments from the prospect included.

Why this is time-sensitive: they want procurement approval next week to start a Dec pilot. Volume estimate inside usage_forecast.xlsx looks modest (pilot committed spend ~ $120k over 6 months across both clouds).

My recommendation for deal desk consideration:
- Approve a one-time bundled concession equal to 30% of first-year equivalent on committed pilot spend (capped at $50k total concession),
- Waive listing fee for 90 days (to allow them to onboard),
- Require a committed pilot PO and a DocuSign'd private offer with explicit term.

Can we get a quick exception approval or do we need Finance/legal sign-off? If yes, I'll communicate back to Matt and route the DocuSign.

Camila
Account Exec — Retail/Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments forwarded: pilot_SOW.pdf, usage_forecast.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 13:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot: cross-cloud listing + private offers for early access

Camila — thanks for the summary and for surfacing the numbers. I reviewed the forecast and SOW. Recommendation from Deal Desk (approved subject to Finance acknowledgment):

1) Concession: approve up to 30% blended credit on the first-year equivalent of the committed pilot spend, capped at $50,000 total concession.
2) Listing fee: waive the one-time listing fee for 90 days (standard bridge concession).
3) Term: concession applies only to the committed pilot PO for the 6-month window; no automatic renewals.
4) Legal/Contracting: we need contracting to include the concession language in the private offer and the SOW; include a clawback clause if the PO is canceled within 30 days.

Lauren — can Finance confirm there's no additional approval tier required for a $50k cap? If not, Camila can proceed to send a DocuSign private offer and folder the SOW into the shared drive.

Ben
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Internal reference: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/DEAL/Exceptions#RDW-ACCT-7893

Matt — good news: Deal Desk has approved a pilot concession. Summary below (formal private offer will be sent via DocuSign):

- Concession: 30% blended credit applied to the first-year equivalent of the committed pilot spend, capped at $50,000 total.
- Listing fee: waived for 90 days from listing activation (both AWS and Azure).
- Term: 6-month pilot, North America region only.
- Conditions: signed PO + DocuSign'd private offer and SOW. Clawback applies if PO is canceled within 30 days.

Next steps: I'm initiating the DocuSign private offer now: https://docusign.com/initiate/ABC-7893. Please review and sign; procurement approval should be sufficient to finalize. I've attached the SOW and usage forecast again for your records. Once signed, we'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff with the onboarding team and list the offer in both marketplaces.

Proposed kickoff window: week of Nov 22. Can you confirm availability?

Thanks — excited to get StellarRetail onboarded.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Retail & Marketplaces
Redwood Inference
